meta.name_zh: 兒童及少年保護通報明細檔
meta.name_en: Reported Data of Protection of Child and Youths
meta.data_description_zh:
1. 原則上一次通報一筆資料。
2. 兒童及少年保護通報與分級分類處理及調查辦法依兒童及少年福利與權益保
障法第五十三條規定訂定之。
3. 依兒童及少年保護通報及處理辦法第二條，醫事人員、社會工作人員、教育人員、
保育人員、警察、司法人員、村（里）幹事及其他執行兒童及少年福利業務人員，
於執行業務時知悉有應保護之兒童及少年時，應立即填具通報表以網際網路、電
信傳真或其他科技設備傳送等方式通報直轄市、縣（市）主管機關，至遲不得逾
二十四小時；情況緊急時，得先以言詞、電話通訊方式通報，並於知悉起二十四
小時內填具通報表，送直轄市、縣（市）主管機關。
前項通報人員通報內容應包含通報事由、違反本法第五十三條第一項各款情形、
兒童及少年基本資料及其他相關資訊。
4. 依兒童及少年保護通報及處理辦法第三條，前條以外之任何人知悉有應保護之兒
童及少年時，得以前條規定方式或其他任何方式通報直轄市、縣（市）主管機關。
meta.notes_zh:
1. 被害人及疑似施虐人身分證字號可能為空白。
2. 可複選變項若為複選，會記錄在同一欄位中。
3. 日期相關欄位皆為民國格式，年/月/日為000/00/00者表示不詳，如：0000101，表
示年不詳、1040001表示月不詳、1040100表示日不詳。
4. 疑似嫌疑人相關欄位為主要的疑似嫌疑人資料。
※本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有身分證
字號、院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院日期等欄位
均經屏蔽處理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，並攜出經審核通過
之統計結果，以確保資料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別特定當事人。 1. 被害人個人歸戶及個人資料比對的鍵值：ID_C。
2. 疑似施虐人個人歸戶及個人資料比對的鍵值：ID_D。
meta.name_zh_from_listing: Welfare14_兒童及少年保護通報明細檔
meta.notes_en: 1. From ROC year 99 (2010), the Health Promotion Administration expanded four cancer screenings (colorectal, oral, breast, cervical), providing them through NHI-contracted preventive-care facilities, adding colorectal and oral cancer screening to preventive-care services, and expanding breast-cancer screening to women aged 40 to under 45 who are second-degree relatives at high risk (mother, daughter, sister, grandmother having had breast cancer). 2. The government funds mammography once every 2 years for women aged 45-69; women aged 40-44 with a second-degree-relative family history of breast cancer (grandmother, mother, daughter, sister having had breast cancer) are also offered screening. 3. Mammography: women aged 45-69, and women aged 40-44 with a second-degree-blood-relative history of breast cancer, once every 2 years. 4. Screening dates span July 2004 to December 2024.

meta.name_zh_from_listing: Welfare14_兒童及少年保護通報明細檔(20250624起適用)
meta.notes_en: 1. Taiwan's assisted-reproduction database was established in ROC year 87 (1998); assisted-reproduction institutions periodically report cases treated at their facility (excluding artificial insemination between spouses). 2. The Assisted Reproduction Data Reporting and Management Regulations were made under Article 27(2) of the Assisted Reproduction Act. 3. The 'Assisted Reproduction Data Reporting Regulations' were promulgated in full (15 articles) by DOH order Shou-Guo-Zi No. 0960400731 on 8 August 2007 and took effect on the promulgation date. 4. Data that assisted-reproduction institutions must report: (i) health exams and assessments of gamete donors; (ii) results of procedures using donated gametes; (iii) data on donated gametes or embryos formed from them that were not completed for donation, returned, destroyed, re-donated, or transferred; (iv) data on cases starting ovulation drugs to enter a treatment cycle; (v) assisted-reproduction case data; (vi) data on destruction of the treated couple's gametes or embryos. 5. The drug-start years span ROC 87 to 112 (1998-2023).
